title: FreshCart Daily Sales & Spoilage Report
content: Total store revenue for November 16 reached $6,840.50 across 214 customer transactions. Top-selling items included organic baby spinach (62 bunches), pasture-raised free-range eggs (38 cartons), and organic Gala apples (95 lbs). Total produce shrinkage/spoilage was recorded at $112.40, primarily driven by 14 lbs of bruised organic heirloom tomatoes and 9 bunches of wilted organic kale. Cold storage temperatures remained within the required 34°F–38°F range all day. Night shift restocked 80 bags of organic quinoa and 45 jars of organic cold-pressed olive oil.
